title: the moment at hand
description: Exploring personal growth and overcoming obstacles.
lyrics: I'm gonna pick my head up today I'm gonna break down the walls you put in my way Society won't ever be me And so I climb, baby, I climb Up my destiny Yeah, it's all waiting on me Waiting on me to be home Waiting on me to stop the drugs Stop feeling alone I feel like you're home Oh, sometimes it don't matter Sometimes it don't matter how hard you climb You're gonna fall every time Some things aren't meant for me Some things aren't meant for you I know it makes you sad to think about that How your only ride is just a place inside your mind It'll be better when you think better things when you don't When the negative fuck with your energy And be what we came to see Thanks for watching!
